obligations.requiredProof: Persistent production-CLI regression proves the recognized header and immediate separator emit zero records while each contiguous valid data row emits once.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Count either structural row as data; the emitted-record assertion must fail.

scenarios.title: Genuine rows count exactly once across tables

obligations.requiredProof: A focused failing assertion is captured before repair, then four independent six-row fixtures produce 24 distinct records with direct exact-once summary accounting in the later green run.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Reintroduce structural-row leakage; the focused assertion fails before repair and the later aggregate becomes larger than 24.

obligations.requiredProof: Positive controls accept canonical and legacy heading families with each exact supported path heading.
Negative controls reject unlisted aliases and duplicate, partial, or mixed semantic headings with parser status 4, a stable failure class, and the visible line number.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Replace the path heading with an unlisted alias or add a duplicate semantic heading; recognition must fail.

scenarios.title: Malformed structure and data fail loudly

obligations.requiredProof: Persistent adversarial fixtures prove every malformed separator, malformed row, empty required cell, and recognized-rowless terminal returns parser status 4 through the deterministic diagnostic helper with a stable failure class and visible line; parser text remains distinct from the outer extraction failure.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Replace a structural helper call with a bare status-4 exit or silently skip malformed content; the named diagnostic, visible-line, and failure-layer assertions fail.

scenarios.title: Table boundaries and duplicate tables fail deterministically

obligations.requiredProof: Blank, prose, deeper-heading, equal-or-shallower section-boundary, and end-of-file cases exercise exact terminal behavior; adjacent and separated second tables fail at their visible header line in READ_ROWS and DONE and contribute no records.

testMechanism.negativeControl: Ignore a second table in READ_ROWS or DONE, or inspect beyond the equal-or-shallower section boundary; the state-specific status, line, and record-count assertions fail.
